(i) macrolichen richness is a good proxy for the species richness of epiphytic lichens, (ii) threatened macrolichens are a good proxy for threatened microlichen species richness, and (iii) environmental factors are important predictors for the diversity of epiphitic microlichens, but macrolichens are the best predictor.

macrolichen richness is positively correlated with total microlichen richness and that macrolichens can be used in biodiversity assessments as predictors for total microlichen species richness.
